data.name: Mufaddil
data.gender_notes: Mufaddil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mufaddil is an Islamic name derived from the Arabic word 'faddal', which means to support, benefit, or favor. It signifies someone who is a supporter or benefactor, often used in the context of being kind and helpful to others. The name Mufaddil carries the meaning “Supporter, Benefactor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Mufaddil usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter, benefactor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who supports and uplifts others, reflecting the compassionate and caring nature of Allah.
data.etymology: Mufaddil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporter, Benefactor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mufaddil total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مفضّل
in_arabic.long_meaning: مفضّل هو اسم علم مذكر معناه الأفضل والمميز، مشتق من الفعل فضّل الذي يعني افضل أو اعطى الأفضلية، ولهذا الاسم أهمية دينية وثقافية في التراث الإسلامي حيث يُستخدم لوصف الشخص المتميز والمفضل عند الله

in_urdu.name: مفضّل
in_urdu.long_meaning: مفضّل کا مطلب ہے بہترین اور نمایاں، یہ نام عربی gốc سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے افضل یا بہترین بنانا، اس نام کی اسلامی روایت میں بہت اہمیت ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کے نزدیک بہترین اور مفضّل شخص کی وضاحت کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मुफ़अद्दिल
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुफ़अद्दिल का अर्थ होता है उत्तम और विशिष्ट, यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है सर्वश्रेष्ठ या उत्तम बनाना, इस नाम का इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व है क्योंकि यह अल्लाह के पास उत्तम और मुफ़अद्दिल व्यक्ति की व्याख्या करता है

in_pashto.name: مفضّل
